existingDispositions.rationale: Bounded health-attitude change evidence supports intention change; no action inference. Existing general source populations, timing and manipulation bundles need V1 specificity.
Attitude strength changes the consequence of valence; stronger negative attitude need not increase positive behavioral intention. Legacy record itself says moderation was flattened.
Retain context-dependent sign in proposal; expectancy-value formula is not experimental causality. Outcome probability and valence must refer to the same salient outcome.
Outcome value is not action attitude; no causal inference from using valuation as a component of an attitude estimator.
Involvement experiment gives mechanistic leverage but argument sensitivity is an indirect processing indicator. Registered need-for-cognition scale does not establish this exact causal edge.
Prior opinion and involvement change source-cue effects. Perceived-source manipulation checks and attitude outcomes do not automatically identify belief confidence causality.
Message-quality manipulation and its check are not an independently manipulated latent perceived-strength variable; opinion outcome is not always factual belief confidence.
Counterarguments against a message and confidence in one's original belief have different referents. One negative generic edge can encode the wrong sign.
Therapeutic epistemic-trust theory and organizational-trust theory do not identify a general causal increase in confidence in an arbitrary proposition; SRC166 DOI conflict compounds alignment risk.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Additional exposure to the same claim changes subsequent belief confidence.
gapQuestions.rationale: Discovery path resolved to scoped REL-CAND-PSY-LAYER-0001, not an additional proposition. Accuracy task, claim plausibility and population boundaries remain explicit; human decision pending.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Correction detail reduces belief in the corrected false claim.
gapQuestions.rationale: Refutation package changes explanation, warning and sourcing together; cannot isolate quantity of detail. One-day versus week contrasts differ.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Exposure acts through PSY-067 Familiarity to increase belief.
gapQuestions.rationale: No pathway-specific transmitted effect or independently identified mediator extracted; reachability and fluency theory are insufficient.
Dimension-specific strength versus valence must be independent; preserve REL-PSY-002 retype review as same shared question.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Success expectancy and self-efficacy may overlap under aligned task success criteria.
gapQuestions.rationale: Capability, opportunity and motivation can dissociate; identity not justified.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Belief Strength and Metacognitive Confidence may duplicate confidence in the same proposition.
gapQuestions.rationale: Canonical definitions overlap at aligned belief scope; require human boundary decision, not merger or an independently propagating edge.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Satiety changes valuation of a specified food outcome.
gapQuestions.rationale: Meal manipulation versus latent satiety, palatability versus possible-outcome value, and generic BIO definition need exact alignment; do not infer a universal value effect.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Outcome expectancy causes attitude because attitude score is the sum of expectancy × value.
gapQuestions.rationale: Mathematical score contribution is not independently identified causality; duplicate calculation must not propagate.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Favorable attitude is intention and therefore action.
gapQuestions.rationale: Evaluation, commitment and performed behavior are distinct.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Source credibility is the factual accuracy or confidence of every sourced belief.
gapQuestions.rationale: Source attribute, confidence and external truth criterion are different referents; no equivalence.
Search located mood/feedback and motivation studies, but exact feedback contrast and task-probability outcome not sufficiently extracted. No direction invented.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Incentive or institutional rule changes update action-outcome expectancy.
gapQuestions.rationale: Incentive value is not outcome probability; require actual contingency and expectancy measurement, not merely offered money.
Nationality is not an exact canonical Cultural moderator; no formal assertion from a cross-cultural feedback comparison.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Relevance causes elaboration because elaboration was the relevance measure.
gapQuestions.rationale: Circular operationalization; independent constructs must be measured separately.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Noise, disaster or social/institutional shock changes a specified behavior attitude.
gapQuestions.rationale: Screening mostly found risk perceptions and observational beliefs, not temporally identified exact attitude change. No external Family audit or generic shock edge.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Increasing any attitude-strength dimension uniformly increases positive intention.
gapQuestions.rationale: Strongly unfavorable attitude can oppose the behavior; strength is not signed valence.
